name: vergis
description: Vergis — Meta-Cognitive Platform · implementación de referencia de AgencyDomains

scripts.lab:up: docker run -d --platform linux/amd64 --name vergis-tsql-lab -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e 'MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Vergis!Lab2026' -e MSSQL_PID=Developer -p 11433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest
scripts.fab:resume: az fabric capacity resume --resource-group rg-vergis-fabric-lab --capacity-name vergisfablab --subscription $VERGIS_FAB_SUB
scripts.fab:pause: az fabric capacity suspend --resource-group rg-vergis-fabric-lab --capacity-name vergisfablab --subscription $VERGIS_FAB_SUB
scripts.fab:state: az fabric capacity show --resource-group rg-vergis-fabric-lab --capacity-name vergisfablab --subscription $VERGIS_FAB_SUB --query state -o tsv
